mission: Fit the identity-capture-work diagnostic (PR #157) into the ops summary: staging holds 500+ Yuyu identity-capture work items, so its per-item statement hit the 500-row cap and was omitted from the summary (run 38980652834), leaving the remaining-50 work ids unreadable over REST. The file now gives totals by state with id range, the newest 100 items and the 24 h outcomes. Read-only SQL and docs only; no collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no deploy, enqueue or write runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: SELECT-only: adds a states statement and limits the per-item statement to the newest 100 by id. Runs in the existing default_transaction_read_only session.

impact.deployment_impact: One read-only diagnostic and docs. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/, apps/ or .github/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the #157 statement. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: An ops-readonly run that fails on the diagnostic.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: ops-readonly db-diagnostic identity-capture-work shows states, latest_work and outcomes_24h in its ops-summary rows, with the 50 items written by run 38977099606 in latest_work.
